description: This file defines an interface DDataWriter for managing distributed subscriber-topic relations in a pub-sub system, specifically for operations like adding or removing subscribers and addresses, with asynchronous completion handling.

classes.name: DDataWriter
classes.description: An interface for writing subscriber-topic relations in a distributed pub-sub system, supporting operations to add, remove individual subscribers, and remove all subscribers at a given address.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a subscriber with a topic update, returning a future that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the data, returning a future that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes all subscribers associated with a given cluster address, returning a future for completion.
